recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液中可見三顆大型芽細胞，細胞質深藍且邊緣不規則、有尖角或泡狀突起，旁有兩顆中性球，血小板很少；芽細胞帶有 cytoplasmic blebs 是急性巨核母細胞白血病的線索。
features: Three circulating blasts visible at low power
Blasts large with dense nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular, angular or blebbed borders
Two segmented neutrophils; overall leukocytes not increased
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows three circulating blasts, two segmented neutrophils, markedly decreased platelets and mild red cell anisopoikilocytosis. The blasts are large with dense nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm that has irregular, angular to blebbed contours. Fine nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. In a patient with pancytopenia and 21% circulating blasts, findings are suggestive of acute megakaryoblastic leukemia, which requires immunophenotypic confirmation with CD41/CD61.

ddx.vs: Agranular blasts may look similar, but megakaryoblasts express CD41/CD61/CD42b whereas AML-M0 lacks them.
APMF shows trilineage proliferation with marked fibrosis and fewer overt megakaryoblasts; biopsy and immunophenotype are required.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm without blebs and express lymphoid markers (CD19 or cCD3).
